description: This file implements the gl::HandleAllocator class, which manages allocation and deallocation of OpenGL handles, including handle reuse, range management, and logging features.

classes.name: HandleAllocator
classes.description: Class responsible for allocating, releasing, reserving, and resetting GL handles with range management and logging.

classes.name: HandleRangeComparator
classes.description: Comparator struct used for range comparison in handle range management.

methods.name: HandleAllocator
methods.description: Default constructor initializing handle range and internal state.

methods.name: HandleAllocator
methods.description: Constructor initializing handle range with a maximum handle value.

methods.name: setBaseHandle
methods.description: Sets the base handle value, resetting the allocator's starting point.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a handle, reusing released handles if available, otherwise from the unallocated range.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a handle, adding it to the pool of reusable handles.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves a specific handle, removing it from the pool of available handles.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the allocator to initial state, clearing all ranges and handle pools.

methods.name: enableLogging
methods.description: Enables or disables logging of handle allocation and release activities.
